mentions.name: SoundLeaf
mentions.description: A native iOS client for Audiobookshelf, the self-hosted audiobook server. Features CarPlay support, offline downloads with background sync, Cloudflare Access support for tunneled servers, and sleep timers that create bookmarks so listeners can remember where they stopped. Podcast support is in progress. It is a solo project with no tracking and no accounts, connecting directly to the user's own server.
mentions.problem: Started because the author's wife couldn't get into the official Audiobookshelf iOS TestFlight beta despite being unable to live without audiobooks.
mentions.audience: iPhone users who self-host their audiobooks
